note: PRD §7.5, FLT-2. The non-http schemes the analyser recognises in a selection, and therefore the ones Open Link will offer to open. It is data so that adding one is a review of this file and not a build, and it is a closed list because a detection here ends in `NSWorkspace.open`: anything not named is left as text. The ten below `tel` are the ones the PRD names by hand; the three system ones above them are on every Mac.
